integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically. An exhaustive small-order coloring enumeration is included only as a stress test and not as evidence for the infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only connected complete multipartite graphs. It does not address arbitrary joins or list/online variants. Bibliographic novelty is supported by targeted full-text and semantic searches, but an equivalent short observation under different terminology remains a residual risk.
title: Strong odd chromatic number of complete multipartite graphs
